review_scope: Current-reader replay of unchanged actual batch

prior_review_and_resolved_finding.resolution: Reviewed policy and independent review are captured before parsing, their original admission guard is verified after checkpoint and before publication, and both sealed policy and current curated-policy SHA must equal the approved policy SHA. Real-generation controls pass for unchanged activation, post-check policy/review mutation refusal, and wrong-policy review refusal before staging.

multiplicity_assessment.meaning: Native strain identity is not an observation identifier. The corrected reader preserves repeated native IDs, original list order, exact duplicate and opposite-polarity observations; strict ID shape, source count and body/typed native replay remain enforced.

scientific_conclusion.approved_disposition: The exact 632 latest source-declared unknown/unavailable strain-association cases may be admitted with this reviewed policy, preserving their uncertainty and provenance.
scientific_conclusion.latest_case_basis: 583 unchanged historical unknown observations plus 49 subsequent actual documented 404 observations resolving former transport failures. No older 404 substitutes for a later transport failure.
scientific_conclusion.native_evidence_retained: All 3344 recipe endpoints and 2712 nonempty strain endpoints retain their original response support. No explicit-empty responses or newly recovered associations were observed.
scientific_conclusion.omitted_assertions: Unknown endpoints support no inferred strain association, positive growth, negative growth, absence or nonexistent-medium assertion. Other independently evidenced sources keep their own claims.
scientific_conclusion.source_limits: Limited SPARQL identity/positive controls and the zero-row query for medium 1366 do not establish complete association data or a fresh atomic source snapshot.

required_downstream_handling: Preserve exact consumed policy/generation identities, current producer completion and native replay; retain the mandatory per-endpoint audit, incomplete association coverage and omitted-assertion interpretation in direct and inherited release qualifications.
activation_scope: Approval applies to these exact policy bytes and the reviewed helper/code. It permits the planned newly sealed qualified child generation; it does not itself publish a pointer, run a graph producer, validate a final graph release, merge GitHub code or publish externally.
